import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('sales_data.xlsx')
print("Columns:", list(df.columns))
print("Shape:", df.shape)
print(df.head(10).to_string())
print(df.dtypes)

import sys, os, glob
print("CWD:", os.getcwd())
print("Files:", os.listdir('.'))
print("Python:", sys.version)
import pkgutil
mods = sorted(m.name for m in pkgutil.iter_modules())
print("Modules:", mods)

import zipfile, re, os

path = 'sales_data.xlsx'
print("File size:", os.path.getsize(path))
z = zipfile.ZipFile(path)
names = z.namelist()
print("Entries:")
for n in names:
    print(" ", n)

for n in ['xl/workbook.xml', 'xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels']:
    if n in names:
        print(f"\n--- {n} ---")
        print(z.read(n).decode('utf-8', errors='replace')[:3000])

import zipfile, re

z = zipfile.ZipFile('sales_data.xlsx')
xml = z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml').decode('utf-8')
print(xml)

import zipfile

z = zipfile.ZipFile('sales_data.xlsx')
for n in ['xl/styles.xml', '[Content_Types].xml']:
    print(f"--- {n} ---")
    print(z.read(n).decode('utf-8'))

import zipfile, shutil, os

SRC = 'sales_data.xlsx'
TMP = 'sales_data_tmp.xlsx'

def edit_xml(data: str, pairs: list) -> str:
    for old, new, label in pairs:
        cnt = data.count(old)
        assert cnt == 1, f"pattern '{label}' found {cnt} times (expected 1)"
        data = data.replace(old, new)
    return data

with zipfile.ZipFile(SRC, 'r') as z:
    entries = {n: z.read(n) for n in z.namelist()}

# --- styles.xml: add percentage numFmt (id 164) and two new cellXfs ---
styles = entries['xl/styles.xml'].decode('utf-8')
styles_pairs = [
    ('<numFmts count="0"/>',
     '<numFmts count="1"><numFmt numFmtId="164" formatCode="0.0%;-0.0%;-"/></numFmts>',
     'add numFmt'),
    ('<cellXfs count="3">', '<cellXfs count="5">', 'bump cellXfs count'),
    ('</cellXfs>',
     '<xf numFmtId="164" fontId="0" fillId="0" borderId="0" pivotButton="0" quotePrefix="0" xfId="0"/>'
     '<xf numFmtId="164" fontId="1" fillId="0" borderId="0" pivotButton="0" quotePrefix="0" xfId="0"/>'
     '</cellXfs>',
     'append new cellXfs'),
]
styles = edit_xml(styles, styles_pairs)
entries['xl/styles.xml'] = styles.encode('utf-8')

# --- sheet1.xml: add column H (Profit Margin %) ---
sheet = entries['xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'].decode('utf-8')
sheet_pairs = [
    ('<dimension ref="A1:G10"/>', '<dimension ref="A1:H10"/>', 'dimension'),
    ('</cols>', '<col width="14" customWidth="1" min="8" max="8"/></cols>', 'col H'),
    ('<c r="G1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit</t></is></c></row>',
     '<c r="G1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit</t></is></c>'
     '<c r="H1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit Margin %</t></is></c></row>',
     'header H1'),
]
for r in range(2, 10):
    g = f'<c r="G{r}"><f>E{r}-C{r}*F{r}</f><v></v></c>'
    h = f'<c r="H{r}" s="3"><f>G{r}/E{r}</f><v></v></c>'
    sheet_pairs.append((g, g + h, f'data row {r}'))
sheet_pairs.append(
    ('<c r="G10"><f>SUM(G2:G9)</f><v></v></c>',
     '<c r="G10"><f>SUM(G2:G9)</f><v></v></c>'
     '<c r="H10" s="4"><f>G10/E10</f><v></v></c>',
     'total row 10'),
)
sheet = edit_xml(sheet, sheet_pairs)
entries['xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'] = sheet.encode('utf-8')

with zipfile.ZipFile(TMP, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
    for n, data in entries.items():
        z.writestr(n, data)

shutil.move(TMP, SRC)
print("OK - added Profit Margin % column H (formulas G/E), total row G10/E10")
